name: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser
summary: In Gadgetzan, Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser searches the desert for water. He investigates trouble around the town’s supply and asks adventurers to find the missing Junior Surveyor Scrimshank.

sections.title: A Search for Water Gone Wrong
sections.body: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser works from Gadgetzan, where water is always scarce. Wastewander bandits seize nearby wells and water holes, so the Gadgetzan Water Company sends scouts farther into the dunes to seek new sources. Fizzledowser gives them dowsing widgets and directs some toward Sandsorrow Watch. Yet his probes keep finding underground insect hives instead of clean springs. The shortage now comes with a new danger.

sections.title: Uncovering the Silithid
sections.body: Armored insects that burrow through the sand ambushed the survey crews. Fizzledowser and Alchemist Pestlezugg examined the specimens, while Junior Surveyor Scrimshank disappeared inside the Gaping Chasm. The insects proved to be silithid, a coordinated vanguard force rather than ordinary desert pests. Fizzledowser's findings point to a danger that could overwhelm southern Kalimdor. He sets goblin neutrality aside and sends word to scholars of both the Horde and the Alliance.

faq.answer: Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser oversees fieldwork for the Gadgetzan Water Company. He searches Tanaris for wells to keep Gadgetzan supplied.

faq.q: What is the Gadgetzan Water Company?
faq.answer: The Gadgetzan Water Company works from Gadgetzan to secure, process, and distribute water across arid Tanaris. There, water is the most valuable commodity.

faq.q: What happened to Junior Surveyor Scrimshank?
faq.answer: Junior Surveyor Scrimshank is missing. Fizzledowser asks adventurers to investigate his disappearance.

faq.q: Why is Fizzledowser concerned about the desert insects?
faq.answer: Fizzledowser investigates troubling insect activity and disruptions to Gadgetzan's water supply. He gathers evidence for further study.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can appreciate Fizzledowser's custom goblin dowsing widgets. They are built to find water beneath the shifting sands.
